title: Charge actual originals in the general expected fresh-P bound
statement: Reverse the paired perturbation: Q uniform, P perturbed. The same count-flux event now charges the differing original prior, giving m+E N_P>=c m/[eta(1+sqrt(m/d)+eta m/d)]. At m=ceil(d/eta), sufficiently small eta, subtraction of m yields E N_P=Omega(d/eta^(3/2)); the separate perturb-Q family gives the same order for N_Q. Do not sum the two at one target. The all-regime candidate Theta(m+d/eta), and therefore a uniform exact critical-batch routine costing O(d/eta), are disproved. Existing upper O(d/eta^2) at this batch leaves a genuine gap; no positive minimax solution follows.
